description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlement entity class for the OrangeHRM system, describing leave entitlement records associated with employees, including properties like number of days, date ranges, leave type, and related metadata.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlement
classes.description: Represents an employee's leave entitlement record with properties like number of days, date range, leave type, and associated metadata.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the record's unique identifier.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the record's unique identifier.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the associated Employee object.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the associated Employee object.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Returns the number of leave days allocated.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the number of leave days, formatted to 4 decimal places.

methods.name: getDaysUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of leave days used.

methods.name: setDaysUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of leave days used, formatted to 4 decimal places.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the LeaveType associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the LeaveType associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the entitlement period.

methods.name: getCreditedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the entitlement was credited.

methods.name: setCreditedDate
methods.description: Sets the credited date; nullable.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any notes associated with the entitlement.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets notes associated with the entitlement.

methods.name: getEntitlementType
methods.description: Returns the LeaveEntitlementType object.

methods.name: setEntitlementType
methods.description: Sets the LeaveEntitlementType object.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the record is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks or unmarks the record as deleted.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who created the record.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who created the record.
